# AetherCalc contributor instructions

- `index.html` is generated by `build.py`. Make markup and CSS changes in the
  generator, run `npm run build`, and commit both files.
- Preserve the no-JavaScript runtime. Run `npm test` for behavior, script-tag,
  favicon, accessibility, and narrow-viewport checks.
- StuntCamp deploys the full commit SHA pinned as `build.ref` in
  `kypflug/stuntcamp` at `registry/apps/aethercalc.json`. After an AetherCalc
  change merges to `main`, open a StuntCamp PR that updates this ref to the
  merged commit. Merging only the AetherCalc PR does not deploy it.
